items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: Like I was with Lester Lanin's society band

ctx.x: That's right, a big piano player then. He was the one who made Stardust, didn't he?

Stardust. He made Stardust way back then and was a big hit, uh huh. And then, well, you know, I was one of those kinds of musicians that I wanted to play all types of music -- I just didn't want to be playing jazz alone, so I tried to play almost everything, you know? Like I was with Lester Lanin's society band, and I worked with Jerry Jerome, and Charlie Scardino.
Yeah, Scardino. His wife was a piano player.
